ns2:course.label: School and Community Experience
ns2:course.description: Early field experiences in teacher education, including observation and laboratory experiences in schools: Designed to provide opportunities for career exploration, professional orientation, the development of insight into the relationships of theory and practice, and the place of the student in the educational process. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Must be admitted to an educator preparation program.
